messages:
Priya: HelixBoard (CISO + CTO) asked for an accelerated summary for board signoff. Key asks: 1) BYO KMS / HSM attestation, 2) egress lock to their VPC endpoints, 3) hosted vs dedicated cost for ~10M tokens/mo + overage terms. Need board-ready slide by Fri 5pm PT.

Ethan: I'll own pricing + fallback path. Do they want committed throughput or an initial hosted trial with committed start after signoff?

Priya: Sales note: they prefer a reserved 12mo commit but will accept a hosted-to-reserved transition if we provide clear migration plan and pricing delta.

Noah: Technical: for egress lock we need their peering details and a list of allowed IPs/CIDRs. For BYO KMS we can provide an attestation; HSM cert chain is possible but may take 48 hours to redact and approve with legal. Example network acl I can share during prep.

Claire: Legal: we can provide a redacted HSM attestation + SOC2 excerpts. Also raising a compliance flag about their "no-logs" requirement on specific routes; need product signoff before committing.

infra-bot: Temp demo env created: rbw-demo-helixboard-2425, expiry 72h. Network diagram uploaded: /shared/bridges/helixboard-2425.png

Ethan: Action plan: pricing slide + two scenarios (hosted vs 12mo reserved) by EOD Thurs. Also include canary fallback and SLA differences.

Noah: I'll draft the attestation template and sample agent config. Pinged eng-infra to validate NIC driver compatibility they mentioned earlier.

Claire: I'll prepare redacted SOC2 pages and a short legal summary; can sign attestation template once draft is final.

Priya: Let's run a prep call Thu 9am PT (SRE + SE + Legal + Sales). Exec bridge Fri 10am PT. I'll send invites and the single-slide packet beforehand. Keep updates here only.

Ethan: I'll post the preliminary cost calc here when ready.

Noah: Will follow up with eng-infra and paste any driver logs.

Priya: Thanks team — please escalate any blocker directly to me.
